answer.worked: The matching angles are M with X ($20^\circ$), N with Y ($130^\circ$), and the matching sides NO and YZ are each $10\text{ cm}$. Thus AAS gives $\triangle MNO\cong\triangle XYZ$.

answer.worked: Both have a right angle, the equal hypotenuses BC and TS are $25\text{ cm}$, and the matching legs AC and RS are $7\text{ cm}$. Hence $\triangle ABC\cong\triangle RTS$ by RHS.
